LanguageData.NHTCD_Header: {0} of {1} races loaded. Unset slots fall back in order: gender, then body type, then any doll.
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecAssignSub: Pick the doll set for each race. The buttons are: default, male, female, body type.
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecHairSub: Hair only: recoloring, which coordinates apply, skeleton view and shadow handling.
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecColorSub: Parts only: master color toggle, color variants, per-part and per-race grayscale.
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecAddonsSub: Follow-through and hit testing for HAR addons (halo, ahoge, tail).
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecDebugSub: For troubleshooting only; adds diagnostic entries to the log.
LanguageData.NHTCD_SecBuiltinPatchesSub: Optional fixes bundled with this mod. Off by default; enabling takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.NHTCD_RjwLayoutAdapt: RJW genitalia panel follows the doll column
LanguageData.NHTCD_RjwLayoutAdaptHint: Positions the Nice Health Tab - RJW Genitalia panel, button and anus window against the actual doll column size, and restores per-pawn part state in custom-drawn columns such as LFS UI (missing chest texture, missing anus window, empty genital slots). Requires that RJW addon; disabling it restores the original mod behaviour.
LanguageData.NHTCD_RjwAddonPresent: Active: Nice Health Tab - RJW Genitalia
LanguageData.NHTCD_RjwAddonAbsent: Nice Health Tab - RJW Genitalia not detected; these switches have no effect
LanguageData.NHTCD_InactiveHint: Race not found: its mod is not loaded, or the patch was skipped.
LanguageData.NHTCD_BodyHint: Pick a doll per body type
LanguageData.NHTCD_NoDolls: No race dolls found yet. Drop the editor's HumanlikeDoll XML into Defs/.
LanguageData.NHTCD_TintVanillaHair: Recolor non-HAR hairstyles with hair color
LanguageData.NHTCD_ShowHairInXray: Show hair in Bones / Organs view
LanguageData.NHTCD_HarHairCoords: Use in-game coordinates for HAR hair
LanguageData.NHTCD_HarHairCoordsHint: When off, HAR hair uses the editor coordinates. HAR races only.
LanguageData.NHTCD_VanillaCoords: Use custom coordinates for non-HAR hair
LanguageData.NHTCD_AutoFixHair: Auto-correct misplaced hair (cached after first check)
LanguageData.NHTCD_DesatCustomUsed: Some parts are set to grayscale individually.
LanguageData.NHTCD_DesatNoParts: No parts are flagged as "controlled by the part color switch" yet. Tick them in the editor.
LanguageData.NHTCD_ColorOffHint: Ticked means that race is not tinted by hair color
LanguageData.NHTCD_AddonsHint: With addon follow off, halos and ahoge are drawn as static textures. With hitbox offset off, offsets authored in the editor are ignored.
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnNonHar: With tinting on, injured head decorations and ears no longer show wound layers.
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnSync1: Race sync also applies scale and offsets,
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnSync2: custom coordinates and color display; resetting also resets the whole race.
LanguageData.NHTCD_WarnMore: More options: Options → NHT Custom Dolls.
LanguageData.NHTCD_RjwHairOverChestHint: When on, hair is drawn above the chest and nipples. Turn it off to restore the original RJW order (chest over hair).
